title: js65 project file
description: Project descriptor. `js65 build` and the language server uses this to build your project.

$schema.description: Optional pointer at this schema, for editors that do not map js65.json automatically.

outDir.description: Directory build outputs are written to. Defaults to `build`.

projects.description: Each entry is for a fully assembled and linked program.

name.description: Project name. Used as the default name for output files. Defaults to the first source file's basename, or the directory holding this file.

sources.description: Source files assembled for this project. Globs are allowed: `*` and `?` stay inside one folder, `**` spans folders. Matching is case-sensitive on every platform, matches are sorted, and a pattern that matches nothing is an error.

includePaths.description: Search path for `.include`. Globs not allowed here.

binIncludePaths.description: Search path for `.incbin`. Globs not allowed here.

linkerConfig.description: Optional path to an ld65 config file, used in place of a built-in `target` or `segment` definitions.

target.description: Built-in basic segment layout. `sim` is a headerless 64KB address space for tests and tools.

output.description: Linked output file, relative to `outDir`. Defaults to `<name>.nes`.

dbgfile.description: Debug info (MLB labels) output, relative to `outDir`.

mapfile.description: Linker map (free space / placed chunks) output, relative to `outDir`.

format.description: Output format. `binary` links a ROM, `ips` emits a patch against `baseRom`, `object` writes unlinked modules.

baseRom.description: ROM file that is used as the original data for the patch or final output.

defines.description: Symbols defined before assembly, as if passed with `-D NAME=VALUE`.

features.description: Assembler features to enable, as if passed with `--feature`.

debug.description: Debug info level. -1 disables debug info entirely.

allowJavascript.description: Lets this project's `.jsbegin` blocks run, as if passed with `--allow-javascript`.

lint.description: Lint configuration for every project in this file. Lints run by default. A single line can also be silenced with a `; js65-lint-disable-next-line RULE` comment.

enabled.description: Set false to turn off every lint rule in this project.

rules.description: Level per rule. A rule not listed here keeps its default level.

bare-number-operand.description: A lone decimal/binary literal used as an address, e.g. `lda 5`. Default: warning.

suspicious-address-expr.description: A lo/hi byte expression used as an address, e.g. `lda <label`. Default: warning.

endproc-no-terminator.description: `.endproc` whose last instruction falls through. Default: warning.

jsr-rts-tail-call.description: `jsr` immediately followed by `rts`, which could be a `jmp`. Default: info.

jmp-fallthrough.description: `jmp` to the label defined on the next line. Default: info.

suspicious-line-continuation.description: A `\` statement separator at the end of a line, which continues nothing. Default: warning.
